sutta: 1.52 What is good by not decaying? What is good when made secure? What is the precious gem of humans? What cannot be stolen by thieves? And the Buddha said, "Virtue is good by not decaying. Faith is good when made secure. Wisdom is the precious gem of humans. Merit cannot be stolen by thieves." So the Buddha here is saying that virtue uh does not decay. If you have virtue, and then faith, uh if it is in good faith, a secure faith, then it is good for you, beneficial. And wisdom is the precious gem of humans. Uh it's one very valuable thing that we should aim for, possess. And if you have merit from good karma, thieves cannot steal it away. Uh you will bring it with you wherever you go, even in a future lifetime.
